agent_id.description: Agent the round belongs to. When set, only the investigator gets trees; the reinforcement hydrate workflow omits it.

prompt.description: The round message. Reinforcement messages carry an accessed-trees marker; without it every tree is written (investigator hydrate).

sandbox_id.description: Workspace key from nightshift.obtainSandbox. Already space-scoped.

conversation_id.description: Unscoped conversation id derived from the sandbox key.

failed.description: The write failed; its contents may be incomplete.

hydrated_ids.description: Canonical symptom:<slug> tree ids materialized into the sandbox.

notification.description: Always empty on success. On failure, the incomplete-materialization notice for /workspace/decision-trees.

tree_count.description: Number of decision trees written into the sandbox.
